title: WPMS/1101/2020 of BHAGWATI STORE Vs COMMISSIONER GARHWAL MANDAL PAURI GARHWAL UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPMS No.1101 of 2020
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Pankaj Miglani, Advocate for the
petitioner.
 Mr. N.S. Pundir, Deputy Advocate General
with Mr. S.R. Joshi, Standing Counsel for the
State/respondent no.1.
 Mr. Rahul Consul, Advocate for respondent
no. 2.
 The petitioner has raised a construction on his
building without any sanction from the Development
Authority i.e. Mussoorie Dehradun Development
Authority, it is alleged by the Development
Authority.
 The petitioner, on the other hand, would argue
that he had purchased the property and all he was
doing was repair work, if at all. The same is liable to
be compounded he states or even if some
unauthorised construction is liable to be demolished,
he will do the same.
 However, since the sealing is to take place
today itself, the petitioner seeks indulgence of this
Court.
 Learned counsel for the Development
Authority, however, on the other hand, would also
argue that against the order of the Commissioner, the
petitioner has a remedy to file a revision before the
Uttarakhand Housing Urban Development
Authority, as provided under Section 7-B of the
Uttarakhand Urban and Country Planning and
Development Act, 1973.
 In view of this fact, no interference is liable to
be made by this Court.
 Consequently, the writ petition is dismissed in
limine on ground of alternative remedy available to
be petitioner to file a revision before the Uttarakhand
Housing Urban Development Authority.
